items.title: EARLE ELLIS
items.author: Jesus' Use of the Old Testament and the Genesis of New Testament Theology - E
items.why: This source directly addresses the fulfillment of Old Testament themes in relation to Jesus, making it highly relevant to the claims regarding Jesus' relationship to Genesis. It likely explores the broader theological implications, which may include Israel's rejection of Jesus and the transition from his physical presence to a Spirit-mediated presence, making it a comprehensive resource for the argument presented.
